name: Benchmark v1.0
description: This preregistration records Benchmark v1.0 for a controlled study of whether AI-mediated compression preserves distinctions in institutional state that are relevant to downstream decision processes. The benchmark contains twelve paired cases covering epistemic status, contestation, normative status, and procedural allocation, together with benign controls, gold summaries, symbolic ground truth, predefined outcome measures, and five prespecified failure conditions. The primary analysis compares critical-state recovery from full records and AI-generated summaries under matched access to downstream procedural rules. Additional preregistered analyses examine distinction survival, downstream decision accuracy, false indeterminacy, false determination, decision dependency, gold-summary controls, and self-system versus cross-system use of intermediate representations. Cross-system findings will be interpreted only as observations concerning the specific systems tested. No independence of model families, training data, errors, or representations is assumed. Exploratory analyses include directional state distortion, including institutional elevation and demotion. Exploratory outcomes will not be represented as preregistered hypotheses. Five failure conditions were specified before experimental model outputs were obtained. No experimental model outputs had been obtained at the time of registration.
